list.name: instance
list.label: Instance
list.description: Observer and Composer instances in this deployment. All includes both RPC/indexer and native queue sources without combining their recording-rule populations.

panels.title: Queue evaluation
panels.description: Current means the runtime evaluated queue readiness recently. It does not prove cross-chain completion.

panels.title: L1 reference lag
panels.description: Unknown until an independent L1 reference is configured. Negative values mean the reference is behind.

panels.title: Active cross-chain requests
panels.description: Disjoint queue states plus in-flight requests. Unknown when readiness evaluation or collection is unavailable. An empty queue is idle, not evidence of a healthy cross-chain execution path. Consult retained canonical successes in the protocol dashboard when enabled.

panels.title: Oldest pending request
panels.description: Sampled wall-clock maximum; an empty or unknown age is not zero.

panels.title: L2 head, safe and finalized settlement over time
panels.description: Latest L2 RPC head, optional verified node-reported safe tag, and exact applied L2 hash with finalized L1 evidence. These are different assurances. Missing/stale capabilities remain gaps.

panels.title: L1 head and finalized block age over time
panels.description: Age of actual block timestamps, not time since polling. Optional finalized indexing remains unknown until covered. Shared tooltip compares fresh head age with exact finalized-block age.

panels.title: Safe-head and explorer lag over time
panels.description: Latest canonical head minus a separately verified safe/explorer reference. Ahead, conflicting, disabled or stale observations remain unknown. Explorer height is not proof of a complete historical index.

panels.title: L2 block interval · mean and p95 / 5m
panels.description: Time between exact parent-linked consecutive canonical L2 blocks. Missing parents and backwards timestamps remain unknown; equal timestamps are zero. Bucketed by child block time. This is production cadence, not transaction latency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text AS metric,avg(r.interval_seconds)::double precision AS mean_seconds,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY r.interval_seconds)::double precision AS p95_seconds FROM eez.canonical_block_activity r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.source_valid AND c.role='l2' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: L2 transactions per block · mean and maximum / 5m
panels.description: All transactions reported by complete block bodies, including protocol/system transactions where present; not just cross-chain sources or successful user transactions. Mean and maximum over covered canonical blocks. See transaction coverage beside empty-block fraction. Old uncollected bodies remain unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text AS metric,avg(r.transaction_count)::double precision AS mean_transactions,max(r.transaction_count)::double precision AS maximum_transactions FROM eez.canonical_block_activity r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.source_valid AND c.role='l2' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: L2 empty blocks and transaction-count coverage / 5m
panels.description: Empty means a complete block body with zero transactions. Empty percentage uses only covered blocks; coverage is the proportion of indexed canonical blocks with a known transaction count. Neither index gaps nor unavailable bodies are fabricated as empty blocks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text AS metric,100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.transaction_count=0)/NULLIF(count(r.transaction_count),0) AS empty_percent,100.0*count(r.transaction_count)/count(*) AS covered_percent FROM eez.canonical_block_activity r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.source_valid AND c.role='l2' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Whole-chain execution gas utilization / 5m
panels.description: Sum of gas used divided by sum of gas limits for covered canonical blocks, separately per chain. Includes every transaction, unlike selected cross-chain receipt gas. Missing/zero limits remain unknown. Header coverage is shown below; utilization is not a throughput benchmark.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text AS metric,100.0*sum(r.gas_used) FILTER(WHERE r.gas_limit>0 AND r.gas_used IS NOT NULL)/NULLIF(sum(r.gas_limit) FILTER(WHERE r.gas_limit>0 AND r.gas_used IS NOT NULL),0) AS utilized_percent FROM eez.canonical_block_activity r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: L1 blobs per block · mean and maximum / 5m
panels.description: Global L1 blob gas used divided by 131072 blob gas per blob. Includes all L1 applications, not just EEZ. Known zero is retained; missing pre-fork/unavailable header fields remain unknown. No percentage of a guessed fork-dependent blob limit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text AS metric,avg(r.blob_gas_used)/131072.0 AS mean_blobs,max(r.blob_gas_used)/131072.0 AS maximum_blobs FROM eez.canonical_block_activity r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.source_valid AND c.role='l1' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: L1 excess blob gas · mean and maximum / 5m
panels.description: Global L1 excess blob gas from canonical headers: accumulated blob fee-market pressure. This is gas, not a monetary fee, current block usage or an EEZ queue. Missing fields stay unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text AS metric,avg(r.excess_blob_gas)::double precision AS mean_excess_blob_gas,max(r.excess_blob_gas)::double precision AS maximum_excess_blob_gas FROM eez.canonical_block_activity r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.source_valid AND c.role='l1' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Canonical block metadata coverage / 5m
panels.description: Coverage within indexed canonical blocks, separately per chain. Historical rows collected before schema23 lack activity metadata unless revisited by bounded repair; they are not zero activity. This ratio does not assert gap-free chain indexing. Stale/failed/frozen collection suppresses all activity queries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text AS metric,100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.gas_used IS NOT NULL AND r.gas_limit>0)/count(*) AS execution_header_percent,CASE WHEN min(c.role)='l1' THEN 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.blob_gas_used IS NOT NULL AND r.excess_blob_gas IS NOT NULL)/count(*) END AS blob_header_percent,100.0*count(r.interval_seconds)/count(*) AS parent_interval_percent FROM eez.canonical_block_activity r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

options.content: This overview uses passive chain-head and aggregate queue observations. **Idle / unexercised means no current queued or in-flight work, not verified cross-chain health. Unknown means unavailable or unconfigured.** When enabled, the protocol dashboards show separately retained canonical outcomes, costs, finality and request history. No continuous active canary is configured by this view.

panels.title: L1 finalized indexed height
panels.description: Exact finalized L1 block retained by the canonical indexer. Unknown when indexing is disabled, stale, failed or frozen.

panels.title: L1 finalized block age
panels.description: Age of the exact finalized block timestamp, not time since the last successful poll. Unknown for missing or future timestamps.

panels.title: L2 node-reported safe height
panels.description: Optional identity-checked observations revalidated against exact canonical block hashes. Safe is the node RPC tag, not independently established finality. Explorer height does not prove a gap-free history.

panels.title: L2 node-reported safe lag
panels.description: Latest canonical RPC height minus this verified observation; an ahead, conflicting, unavailable or stale source remains unknown.

panels.title: Explorer highest verified indexed height
panels.description: Optional identity-checked observations revalidated against exact canonical block hashes. Safe is the node RPC tag, not independently established finality. Explorer height does not prove a gap-free history.

panels.title: Explorer highest verified indexed lag
panels.description: Latest canonical RPC height minus this verified observation; an ahead, conflicting, unavailable or stale source remains unknown.

panels.title: L2 finalized settled height
panels.description: Exact applied L2 hash with verified finalized L1 anchor. A node-reported safe tag or matching height alone does not establish this.

panels.title: Safe-head and explorer capability / collection state
panels.description: Disabled, pending, stale and rejected sources remain explicit. Blobscan slot-cursor availability is not a verified indexed block height.
